name: Web Application (Copy)
description: Comprehensive design guidelines for responsive web applications. Covers responsive breakpoints, navigation patterns, grid systems, accessibility standards, and cross-browser considerations.

requirements.name: Responsive Design
requirements.description: App must be fully responsive across all viewport sizes: mobile (320px+), tablet (768px+), desktop (1024px+), wide (1440px+). Use CSS media queries or container queries. Mobile-first approach recommended.
acceptanceCriteria: App must be fully responsive across all viewport sizes: mobile (320px+), tablet (768px+), desktop (1024px+), wide (1440px+)
Use CSS media queries or container queries

userStory.benefit: the interface adapts properly to my screen size
